description: Land Reform Commission - Statutory Determination under Section 19 of the Land Reform Law No. 01 of 1992
categorisation: This gazette content is a statutory determination by the Land Reform Commission regarding the retention of specific agricultural land allotments by a statutory lessee's estate. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels, including lot numbers, extents, names, locations, and plans. The core subject matter is land ownership and property rights, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
